exam.name: Unit Test 2 — Science (Class 5 handwritten test)
exam.subject: Science
exam.instructions: Answer all the questions. Write neatly.

questions.text: Fill in the blanks: a) Plants make their own food by the process of ____. b) Water changes into water vapour by ____. c) The hardest part of our body is the ____ of the teeth. d) The planet closest to the Sun is ____.
questions.model_answer: a) photosynthesis b) evaporation c) enamel d) Mercury

questions.text: Write True or False: a) A bat is a bird. b) Magnets attract iron nails. c) Sound travels faster than light.
questions.model_answer: a) False b) True c) False

questions.text: Name the following: a) The gas we breathe in to stay alive. b) The largest planet in our solar system. c) The organ that pumps blood in our body.
questions.model_answer: a) Oxygen b) Jupiter c) Heart

questions.text: Why should we not waste water? Give two reasons.
questions.model_answer: Any two: very little of Earth's water is fresh/drinkable; all living things need water; wasting it causes shortage; saving water saves energy/money.

questions.text: Write two differences between solids and liquids.
questions.model_answer: Solids have a fixed shape, liquids take the shape of the container; solids cannot flow, liquids can flow. (1 mark each)

questions.text: Draw a neat diagram of the water cycle and label it.
questions.model_answer: Diagram 1 mark; labels evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection 0.5 each.

questions.text: What is a balanced diet? Name two nutrients and one food source for each.
questions.model_answer: Definition (1): food containing all nutrients in the right amounts. Two nutrients with a correct source (1 each).

answers.1: a) photosynthesis b) evaporation c) enamel d) Mercury
answers.2: a) False b) True c) False
answers.3: a) Oxygen b) Jupiter c) Heart
answers.4: Only a small amount of water on Earth is fresh and safe to drink. People, plants and animals all need water to live, so wasting it will cause shortage in future.
answers.5: (i) Solids have a fixed shape but liquids take the shape of the container. (ii) Solids have a fixed volume and cannot flow, but liquids can flow easily.
answers.6: [Diagram: sun, sea, cloud, mountain; labels: evaporation, condensation, rain (precipitation), collection, Sun]
answers.7: A balanced diet is food that has all the nutrients in the right amount which our body needs to stay healthy. Proteins - eggs, dal. Carbohydrates - rice, chapati.
